# uzc_vpn_gateway (Resource)

Creates a VPN gateway on a UzCloud VPC (POST /vpcs/{vpc}/vpn-gateways, which the spec documents as taking no parameters). The resource ID is "{vpc}/{gateway_id}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_vpn_gateway" "example" {
  vpc = uzc_vpc.example.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc` (String) Slug of the uzc_vpc to create the gateway on. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `gateway_id` (String) Server-assigned gateway id.
- `id` (String) "{vpc}/{gateway_id}". Used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_vpn_gateway.example <vpc-slug>/<gateway-id>
```
